name: agentremote-bridge
description: Companion plugin for agentremoted interactive mode: forwards CodeBuddy Code lifecycle events (SessionStart, Stop, Notification, SessionEnd, compaction, AskUserQuestion) to the local agentremoted daemon. Loaded only into daemon-spawned tmux TUIs via --plugin-dir; a manual session with this plugin loaded silently no-ops unless AGENTREMOTE_HOOK_URL is set.
